clauses.text:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution of the United  
States of America, and in order to enlarge the membership of the Energy  
Coordinating Committee, Section 1-102 of Executive Order No. 12083 of  
September 27, 1978, is hereby amended by adding in alphabetical order the  
following:
“(x) The Director of the Community Services Administration.
. “(y) The Chairman of the Council on Wage and Price Stability.”.

own_original_text:
Executive Order 12121 of February 26, 1979
Energy Coordinating Committee
p
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution of the United  
States of America, and in order to enlarge the membership of the Energy  
Coordinating Committee, Section 1-102 of Executive Order No. 12083 of  
September 27, 1978, is hereby amended by adding in alphabetical order the  
following:
“(x) The Director of the Community Services Administration.
. “(y) The Chairman of the Council on Wage and Price Stability.”.
THE WHITE HOUSE,  
February 26, 1979.

versions.research_rationale:
EO 12121 (signed 1979-02-26; 44 FR 11195, Federal Register of February 28, 1979) was read in full in the held Federal Register text (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12121.txt, PDF page 19), with EO 12083 (the parent order), EO 12156, EO 12288 and EO 12379 read in their held Federal Register texts. Identity, page and date confirmed. The order is a one-sentence amendment of section 1-102 of EO 12083 that adds two members to the Energy Coordinating Committee: the Director of the Community Services Administration and the Chairman of the Council on Wage and Price Stability. First and whole-order end: EO 12379 section 20, which revokes EO 12083 "as amended" (1982-08-17, read as on signing), because the amendment has no operation once the order it amends is revoked; EO 12121 is not named by number, which the clause reason states with the alternative reading. Later event: the EO 12156 further amendment of the same section. The U.S. Code machine search records one mention of this order, an Office of the Law Revision Counsel note under 42 U.S.C. 7101 stating that EO 12083, "as amended by Ex. Ord. No. 12121, Feb. 26, 1979, 44 F.R. 11195" and by EO 12148, "was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 12379, § 20, Aug. 17, 1982, 47 F.R. 36100"; the eCFR machine search records none. Disclosed earlier candidates under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on unnamed instruments (option C; neither names EO 12121, so neither is the end): (1) the Community Services Administration. An Office of the Federal Register editorial note in the held 1989 codification text (jobs/ofr-codification-1989/output/texts/EO_12344.txt, sha256 747052eb81a27f8e0040ae9c8bd5f478841e46df4e9ba7c683587599624bdbf8; the same note is in EO_12160.txt) states that "The Community Services Administration was abolished through" the repeal of the Economic Opportunity Act of 1964 "by Pub . L. 97-35 (95 Stat . 519, 42 U.S.C. 2941)". The note gives no effective date and the statute is not held, so the date the Director's office ceased is not fixed by a held source beyond falling in or after 1981 and before EO 12379. (2) The Council on Wage and Price Stability. An editorial note in the held 1989 codification text (jobs/ofr-codification-1989/output/texts/EO_12154.txt, sha256 bff5d25514c124e6fc4decb93eeae7ae824204d396dcb03bca755207208da54a) states that "The Council on Wage and Price Stability was abolished by Execu-" tive Order 12288 of Jan. 29, 1981. The held Federal Register text of EO 12288 (jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12288.txt, sha256 995315c4dc9f143a80b008ebfff389f119a3d67afbba6f82fc37508a35da5e6d) does not abolish the Council: it revokes EO 12092 and authorizes the heads of agencies, "including" the Council on Wage and Price Stability, to take steps to terminate actions adopted under EO 12092, which treats the Council as still existing. No held source fixes when the Council ceased, so it is not established that both offices had ceased before 1982-08-17. Even if both had ceased, the Energy Coordinating Committee continued under EO 12083 with its other members, the added entries remained text of section 1-102, and under the ruling the end is the instrument that revokes the amended order, EO 12379. Bounded search: the dossier's three machine searches, chosen after reading their coverage notes, which carry no coverage warning (U.S. Code release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 with GovInfo CFR bulk XML; Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes and operative sentences of 17,521 saved order texts); the Cruden by-number scan of held order texts in the packet's LOOKUPS.md; a literal search of held texts for Community Services Administration, Council on Wage and Price Stability and Energy Coordinating Committee; and the held editorial notes and EO 12288 text cited above.

first_end.mechanism: revocation of EO 12083 'as amended' by EO 12379 section 20, which removes the order amended by EO 12121 (no effective-date wording, read as on signing)

later_events.mechanism: further amendment by EO 12156 section 1-101 (signed 1979-09-10; 44 FR 53073; no effective-date wording, read as on signing), recorded as an event, not an end: it corrects section 5-211 of EO 12148 (signed 1979-07-20; held Federal Register text), which as first issued had added "(x) the Director of the Federal" Emergency Management Agency to section 1-102 of EO 12083 without reference to EO 12121, reusing the letter (x) that EO 12121 had given the Director of the Community Services Administration; EO 12156 corrects that section to read "Section 1-102 of Executive Order No. 12083, as amended by Executive Order" No. 12121, is further amended by adding in alphabetical order (z) the Director of the Federal Emergency Management Agency. Before: section 1-102 includes members (x) and (y) added by EO 12121. After: the same members plus (z). Neither EO 12148 nor EO 12156 removes or alters the two entries added by EO 12121. The clause continues, amended, until EO 12083 is revoked.

whole_order_end.mechanism: revocation of EO 12083 'as amended' by EO 12379 section 20, which removes the order amended by EO 12121 (no effective-date wording, read as on signing)
